prompts.title: عکاسی تبلیغاتی از برگر
prompts.summary: برگر واقعی رستوران را به تصویری حرفه‌ای برای منو و اینستاگرام تبدیل کنید.
prompts.prompt: Create a premium commercial food photograph using the uploaded burger as the strict product reference. Preserve the exact bun, patty count, actual ingredients, proportions, and portion size. Place the burger on a dark matte stone table against a charcoal background. Use warm directional side light to reveal toasted bread, melted cheese and fresh vegetables. Add realistic soft shadows, a slightly imperfect handmade presentation, shallow depth of field, and an elegant restaurant-advertising composition. Keep the food physically plausible; do not invent ingredients. Vertical 4:5, no text, no logos, no watermark.
prompts.tip: از عکس واقعی محصول استفاده کنید؛ اندازه و مواد اولیه نباید تغییر کند.

prompts.title: عکاسی تبلیغاتی از پیتزا
prompts.summary: بافت خمیر، پنیر و مواد روی پیتزا را در یک قاب اشتهابرانگیز نشان دهید.
prompts.prompt: Use the uploaded pizza photo as the exact visual reference. Produce a photorealistic restaurant advertising shot that preserves the original toppings, crust thickness, portion size, and shape. Place the pizza on a rustic dark wooden table with a subtle oven-baked atmosphere. Warm side lighting brings out natural browning, sauce texture and real melted cheese. Photograph from a three-quarter angle with realistic depth and gentle background blur. Avoid exaggerated cheese pulls, artificial steam or ingredients that do not exist. Vertical 4:5. No text, logo or watermark.
prompts.tip: اگر عکس مرجع ندارید، نام و مقدار واقعی مواد روی پیتزا را بنویسید.

prompts.title: مرغ سوخاری ترد و واقعی
prompts.summary: بافت سوخاری و رنگ واقعی غذا را بدون اغراق نشان دهید.
prompts.prompt: Create a natural high-end commercial food photograph based closely on the uploaded fried chicken meal. Preserve the exact number and size of pieces, coating style, sides, packaging and sauce containers. Place the meal on a clean restaurant table with a deep warm neutral background. Use precise side lighting to show crisp golden breading and realistic tiny crumbs. Maintain truthful portion scale and natural texture, with a subtle depth of field. Do not add extra chicken pieces or change the serving arrangement. Vertical 4:5, high resolution. No captions, logos or watermark.
prompts.tip: برای منو، تعداد تکه‌ها و مخلفات باید دقیقاً مطابق سفارش واقعی باشد.

prompts.title: غذای ایرانی در قاب حرفه‌ای
prompts.summary: چلوکباب، خورش و غذاهای سنتی را با حفظ هویت سرو ثبت کنید.
prompts.prompt: Create an authentic editorial photograph of the uploaded Iranian restaurant dish. Preserve the real recipe, portion, plating, rice quantity, garnish and servingware. Photograph at a natural 45-degree angle on a tasteful Iranian restaurant table. Emphasize realistic rice grain texture, actual meat or stew texture, and restrained warm side lighting. Include only a small amount of genuine tabletop context, leaving visual breathing room. No fabricated saffron garnish, inflated meat portion or misleading additions. Photorealistic commercial food styling, vertical 4:5. No writing or watermark.
prompts.tip: این پرامپت برای عکس منوی واقعی بهتر است با تصویر مرجع اجرا شود.

prompts.title: صبحانه کافه از بالا
prompts.summary: یک ترکیب صبحانه را با چیدمان طبیعی و نور صبحگاهی نمایش دهید.
prompts.prompt: Overhead editorial breakfast photograph featuring a flaky golden croissant, a cappuccino with a realistic tulip latte-art pattern, a small dish of butter, berry preserve and a folded linen napkin. Arrange everything with natural spacing on pale marble with delicate grey veining. Warm morning sunlight comes from the top-left, producing gentle directional shadows. Show a few authentic pastry flakes and believable ceramic textures. Balanced asymmetric flat lay, inviting European neighborhood-cafe atmosphere, accurate food proportions, professional food photography. Vertical 4:5. No text, branding or watermark.
prompts.tip: مواد این نمونه را با صبحانه واقعی منوی خودتان جایگزین کنید.

prompts.title: لاته با طرح رُزتا
prompts.summary: عکاسی از لاته با فوم واقعی و نور نرم کنار پنجره.
prompts.prompt: Photorealistic editorial cafe photograph of a freshly poured latte with a physically plausible rosetta latte art pattern in a handmade warm cream ceramic cup. The cup rests on a walnut tabletop beside a folded linen napkin. Golden morning window light from the left creates soft shadows; the coffee has caramel crema and natural microfoam texture. Background: a quiet real independent cafe, gently blurred, with plenty of breathing room. Professional 50mm food photography, authentic small imperfections, warm color palette, vertical 4:5. No text or watermark.
prompts.tip: طرح فوم را واقعی نگه دارید؛ از نقش‌های غیرممکن استفاده نکنید.

prompts.title: نوشیدنی خنک تابستانی
prompts.summary: قطره‌های آب، یخ و لایه‌های نوشیدنی را طبیعی و جذاب ثبت کنید.
prompts.prompt: Editorial commercial photograph of a refreshing iced mango and milk drink in a tall clear glass. Show realistic golden fruit puree, creamy milk, ice cubes and naturally formed condensation droplets. Place the glass on a light oak cafe table near a sunny window, with a modest slice of mango and mint sprig nearby. Bright warm side lighting passes through the glass and accurately reveals the liquid layers. Airy summer atmosphere, crisp focus on glass texture, subtly blurred street outside. Vertical 4:5. Avoid impossible liquid effects; no text, logo or watermark.
prompts.tip: نوع نوشیدنی، مواد، رنگ و ظرف سرو را با محصول خودتان تطبیق دهید.

prompts.title: دسر و کیک از نزدیک
prompts.summary: بافت لایه‌ها و اندازه واقعی یک برش کیک را برجسته کنید.
prompts.prompt: Turn the uploaded dessert reference into a premium but honest pastry photograph. Preserve the exact slice size, frosting, layers, toppings, plate and garnish. Shoot from a low three-quarter angle against a warm neutral cafe background. Use soft window light and precise shallow depth of field to highlight crumb texture, cream consistency and real fruit details. Include a natural fork and a few crumbs without adding ingredients or increasing portion size. Elegant editorial dessert photography, vertical 4:5. No lettering, logo or watermark.
prompts.tip: برای فروش آنلاین، تزئینات تصویر باید همان تزئینات واقعی دسر باشند.

prompts.title: زیباتر کردن عکس واقعی کافه
prompts.summary: نور و کیفیت عکاسی را بهتر کنید، بدون تغییر معماری و مبلمان.
prompts.prompt: Enhance the uploaded real cafe interior as professional hospitality architecture photography. Preserve every existing wall, window, counter, furniture item, seating position and floor-plan detail. Improve exposure, straighten perspective naturally, recover highlights and shadows, and add believable warm light only from the windows and lamps that already exist. Highlight authentic material texture without creating new decor or expanding the space. Clean editorial composition, realistic architectural proportions, vertical 4:5. No additional furniture, customers, signage or watermark.
prompts.tip: برای معرفی شعبه در نقشه‌ها و سایت، وجود فضای واقعی ضروری است.

prompts.title: فضای کافه در شب
prompts.summary: حال‌وهوای صمیمی شب را با نور واقعی و فضای نشستن نشان دهید.
prompts.prompt: Produce a realistic editorial evening photograph based on the actual uploaded cafe interior. Keep the architecture, furniture, existing lights and layout unchanged. Show the natural contrast between deep blue evening outside the windows and warm interior pendant lighting. A real cup of coffee and a glass of water may sit on an existing foreground table without hiding the venue. Cinematic but accurate exposure, intimate hospitality mood, sharp architectural lines and subtle depth. Vertical 4:5. Do not fabricate customers, furniture, candles or lamps. No logo or text.
prompts.tip: اگر از فضای واقعی استفاده می‌کنید، به مشتری تصویری غیرواقعی از محیط وعده ندهید.

prompts.title: استوری معرفی محصول تازه
prompts.summary: یک محصول تازه را در استوری با فضای مناسب تیتر معرفی کنید.
prompts.prompt: Design a premium vertical restaurant Instagram Story visual around the uploaded real food product, preserving exact ingredients and portion size. Use a clean bold composition in the brand colors [BRAND COLORS]. Keep the product prominent in the center or lower half, with deliberate uncluttered negative space in the upper third reserved for a short Persian headline to be added later. Use appetizing but physically plausible lighting and subtle branded graphic shapes. Strong mobile readability, professional advertising art direction, 9:16. Do not render text, price tags, fabricated food, logo or watermark.
prompts.tip: تیتر فارسی را بعداً در ابزار طراحی اضافه کنید تا غلط نوشتاری نداشته باشد.

prompts.title: کاور ریلز غذا
prompts.summary: برای ویدئوی غذایی یک کاور واضح و کلیک‌خور آماده کنید.
prompts.prompt: Create a striking Instagram Reels cover composition using the uploaded real restaurant dish as the hero. Preserve its actual shape, ingredients and size. Use cinematic but realistic side lighting, a restrained high-contrast background in [BRAND COLORS], and enough empty space in the upper central safe area for a 3-to-5-word Persian headline to be placed manually later. Avoid busy props, clutter and exaggerated food scale. Ensure the subject remains recognizable when cropped to a square grid preview. Vertical 9:16, no generated text, logos or watermark.
prompts.tip: محدوده امن نمایش کاور در پروفایل اینستاگرام را بررسی کنید.

prompts.title: ویدئوی کوتاه تبلیغ برگر
prompts.summary: یک ویدئوی سینمایی کوتاه از برگر واقعی تولید کنید.
prompts.prompt: Create a six-second vertical commercial food video based on the uploaded reference image of the restaurant's real burger. Preserve the bun, ingredients, patty count, shape and serving size throughout every frame. Start with a slow controlled camera push-in, then move a small amount sideways as warm light reveals the natural food textures. Include minimal realistic steam only if the product is visibly hot, gentle reflections, consistent shadows and physically plausible motion. No exploding ingredients, no floating toppings, no shape morphing, no added food, no text or watermark. Aspect ratio 9:16.
prompts.tip: برای کیفیت بیشتر، تصویر مرجع واضح و نورخورده باشد.

prompts.title: ویدئوی دم‌آوری قهوه
prompts.summary: حرکت آرام ریختن آب و استخراج قهوه را در چند ثانیه نمایش دهید.
prompts.prompt: A photorealistic eight-second cinematic vertical shot of a barista's hand using a matte black gooseneck kettle to pour a controlled thin stream of hot water into a ceramic V60 dripper. Coffee grounds bloom naturally with tiny bubbles, and dark amber brewed coffee collects in the glass server. Warm side window light, specialty coffee bar with restrained background blur, slow steady camera movement and accurate brewing physics. Hands and equipment stay anatomically and mechanically consistent. No unnatural splashes, speed ramps, text or watermark. Aspect ratio 9:16.
prompts.tip: در ویدئوهای فرایندی، حرکات ابزار و دست‌ها را پس از خروجی بررسی کنید.

prompts.title: بازطراحی خوانایی منو
prompts.summary: چیدمان منو را بدون تغییر قیمت و اطلاعات واقعی پیشنهاد بگیرید.
prompts.prompt: Act as a restaurant menu information designer. Review the uploaded menu text or image. Extract all existing categories, item names, descriptions, prices and variants without inventing information. Propose a clearer Persian right-to-left menu hierarchy for mobile and print. Identify duplicated descriptions, inconsistent naming, unclear modifiers and overly dense sections. Give a revised menu outline, suggested section order, concise item descriptions and notes for an actual designer. Preserve all prices exactly; flag unreadable values instead of guessing. Do not claim any item is a bestseller unless sales data is provided.
prompts.tip: اگر فایل منو یا متن آن ناقص است، مدل باید موارد مبهم را مشخص کند.

prompts.title: کمپین آخر هفته رستوران
prompts.summary: پیشنهاد تبلیغاتی بسازید که تخفیف و حاشیه سود را هم در نظر بگیرد.
prompts.prompt: Act as a practical restaurant marketing strategist. For a [RESTAURANT TYPE] in [CITY] with [TARGET CUSTOMER], create a realistic weekend campaign designed to increase [GOAL] without damaging contribution margin. Ask for any missing cost or price inputs before calculating profitability; do not invent baseline sales. Propose three offers, an Instagram Story concept, a concise Persian caption, front-of-house staff wording, a redemption rule and a simple tracking sheet. State the assumptions and include a stop condition if sales rise but contribution margin falls.
prompts.tip: عدد فروش، بهای تمام‌شده و هدف کمپین را وارد کنید تا پیشنهاد قابل سنجش شود.

prompts.title: کپشن معرفی غذای ویژه
prompts.summary: از ویژگی‌های واقعی غذا یک کپشن کوتاه و قابل انتشار بسازید.
prompts.prompt: Write three original Persian Instagram captions for a restaurant's actual featured dish: [DISH NAME]. Use only these verified ingredients and characteristics: [REAL DETAILS]. Audience: [AUDIENCE]. Tone: confident, specific and warm without clichés or exaggerated claims. Each caption should open with a different strong first sentence, describe one sensory detail honestly, and end with a clear invitation to order or visit. Keep each version under 70 Persian words. Do not invent awards, discounts, customer reactions, health benefits, or unavailable ingredients.
prompts.tip: نام غذا و مواد واقعی را جایگزین کنید؛ ادعای کیفیت اثبات‌نشده نسازید.

prompts.title: پاسخ حرفه‌ای به شکایت مشتری
prompts.summary: برای شکایت آنلاین پاسخ همدلانه و اجرایی تهیه کنید.
prompts.prompt: You are the customer-experience lead of a restaurant. Draft three brief Persian responses to this authentic customer complaint: [COMPLAINT]. Use a calm, accountable tone. Acknowledge the specific problem without blaming the guest, avoid arguing about facts not yet verified, do not promise a refund or compensation unless authorized, and offer a clear private contact route: [CONTACT METHOD]. Give one public reply and one more detailed private-message version. Also suggest a short internal action note for the shift manager. No generic promotional language.
prompts.tip: اطلاعات سفارش یا مشتری را بدون رضایت در متن عمومی منتشر نکنید.

prompts.title: چک‌لیست شروع شیفت
prompts.summary: فهرستی اجرایی از کنترل‌های پیش از بازشدن رستوران بسازید.
prompts.prompt: Act as a restaurant operations consultant. Build a practical Persian opening-shift checklist for a [BUSINESS TYPE] with [NUMBER OF STAFF] people. Organize tasks by role and deadline: kitchen readiness, food safety checks, refrigeration logs, stock availability, cleaning, equipment, cash/POS readiness, reservations and pre-shift briefing. Output a printable table with task, responsible role, status checkbox and escalation action. Distinguish mandatory local food-safety checks from general operational recommendations; never invent legal temperature thresholds or local regulations. Include a five-minute manager briefing agenda.
prompts.tip: قوانین بهداشتی محل کسب را با مقررات رسمی همان شهر یا کشور تطبیق دهید.

prompts.title: چک‌لیست پایان شیفت
prompts.summary: تحویل درست شیفت، ثبت ضایعات و بستن روز را استاندارد کنید.
prompts.prompt: Create a printable Persian restaurant closing-shift checklist for [BUSINESS TYPE]. Cover final orders, safe food storage, labeling, recorded waste, inventory exceptions, cleaning of equipment, closing POS totals, cash handover, incident log, refrigeration checks, waste removal and final security walk-through. Separate operational responsibilities for front of house, kitchen and manager. Use a concise table with action, owner, record needed and checkbox. Add a three-question handover note for the next shift. Avoid invented legal rules and numerical safety limits.
prompts.tip: برای کنترل مالی، میزان اختلاف صندوق و علت آن را جداگانه ثبت کنید.

prompts.title: کارت استاندارد رسپی
prompts.summary: رسپی را به دستور قابل تکرار با وزن و هزینه تبدیل کنید.
prompts.prompt: Act as a restaurant recipe-standardization specialist. Turn the following real recipe notes into a standardized Persian recipe card: [RECIPE NOTES]. Include batch yield, target portion size, exact ingredient amounts, prep steps, cooking steps, plating specifications, storage notes, allergens to verify and quality-control checkpoints. Do not invent missing gram weights, temperatures, shelf life or nutrition. Put missing operational facts in a 'needs confirmation' table. If unit costs are provided, compute total recipe cost and cost per portion and show the formula. Prioritize consistency across shifts.
prompts.tip: وزن‌های اندازه‌گیری‌نشده را حدس نزنید؛ ابتدا در یک سرو واقعی اندازه بگیرید.

prompts.title: افزایش فروش روزهای خلوت
prompts.summary: ایده‌های کم‌هزینه برای روزهایی پیدا کنید که صندلی‌ها خالی می‌مانند.
prompts.prompt: Work as a data-driven restaurant growth adviser. A [BUSINESS TYPE] in [CITY] is slow on [DAY / TIME]. Suggest eight low-cost, testable ways to improve visits or order frequency using local customer occasions, menu bundles, repeat-guest outreach and team execution. For each idea provide target segment, operational effort, expected mechanism, measurement metric, sample Persian promotional copy and one financial risk. Clearly distinguish hypotheses from validated conclusions. Do not claim a guaranteed sales lift. Conclude with a two-week test plan using actual weekly baseline data when available.
prompts.tip: اول علت خلوتی را بررسی کنید؛ هر راهکاری الزاماً مناسب هر محله‌ای نیست.

prompts.title: ایده‌پردازی غذای جدید
prompts.summary: ایده محصول تازه را از مرحله جذابیت تا آزمون هزینه و عملیات ببرید.
prompts.prompt: Act as a menu development consultant for a [RESTAURANT CONCEPT] serving [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Propose five new menu items that fit existing equipment, ingredients and kitchen skill: [CURRENT RESOURCES]. For each provide a concept name, realistic ingredient list, prep complexity, overlap with current stock, probable allergens to verify, portion test plan and differentiation. Avoid making up actual food costs or market demand. Provide a small test protocol to evaluate preparation time, guest feedback, waste and contribution margin before launch.
prompts.tip: به‌جای اضافه‌کردن انبوه مواد جدید، از مواد موجود منو شروع کنید.

prompts.title: آموزش نیروی تازه‌وارد
prompts.summary: برای کارکنان جدید برنامه آموزشی روز اول تا هفتم تدوین کنید.
prompts.prompt: Act as an operations and training lead for a [BUSINESS TYPE]. Draft a seven-day Persian onboarding plan for a new [ROLE]. For each day specify learning goal, practical supervised exercise, food-safety and guest-service topics, demonstration checklist, who signs off, and one measurable skill test. State which tasks require local legal or certification verification, and do not assume the trainee is permitted to work independently on restricted equipment. Make the plan usable by a busy shift manager.
prompts.tip: برنامه را متناسب با نقش واقعی فرد و مقررات محلی تکمیل کنید.

prompts.title: عکاسی بسته‌بندی بیرون‌بر
prompts.summary: بسته واقعی سفارش بیرون‌بر را به شکل حرفه‌ای معرفی کنید.
prompts.prompt: Create a clean premium product photograph from the uploaded real takeaway food package. Keep its exact shape, material, printed markings, food portion and contents unchanged. Place it on a warm neutral tabletop with an elegant realistic shadow and restrained natural sunlight. Show the lid and packaging texture clearly, and allow one believable view into the meal only if already visible in the reference. Professional restaurant delivery advertising photography, crisp focus and natural colors, vertical 4:5. Do not add invented branding, logos, extra products or text.
prompts.tip: برای سفارش‌گیری آنلاین، ظاهر بسته‌بندی و محتویات باید دقیق باشند.

prompts.title: عکاسی پاکت قهوه
prompts.summary: محصول بسته‌بندی‌شده قهوه را برای فروشگاه آنلاین معرفی کنید.
prompts.prompt: Generate a photorealistic product photograph using the uploaded coffee bag as the exact reference. Preserve its printed branding, shape, package dimensions, closure and label details as closely as possible. Position the bag upright on a linen surface with a small ceramic bowl containing roasted beans and a manual grinder softly blurred behind it. Warm directional window light, rich tactile material textures, elegant restrained styling, sharp product focus and realistic shadows. Vertical 4:5. Do not rewrite the label, fabricate certification badges or introduce new products.
prompts.tip: اگر نوشته‌های بسته تغییر کرده‌اند، تصویر نهایی را با عکس اصلی تطبیق دهید.

prompts.title: نظرسنجی تجربه مهمان
prompts.summary: از مشتری بازخوردی بگیرید که به یک تصمیم مدیریتی تبدیل شود.
prompts.prompt: Design a concise Persian customer-experience survey for a [RESTAURANT TYPE] operating both dine-in and delivery. Include no more than seven neutral questions measuring food quality, accuracy, wait time, service and likelihood to return, plus an optional open comment. Avoid leading wording and unnecessary personal data. Recommend a simple weekly dashboard with response count, category breakdown and recurring issues. Explain how to avoid overinterpreting very small samples. Add one brief QR-code invitation message for receipts.
prompts.tip: نظرسنجی باید کوتاه و داوطلبانه باشد؛ اطلاعات شخصی اضافی نخواهید.
